turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on numbers and time words?
turns.tutor:
Sure! Half past nine is 9:30, quarter past nine is 9:15, and quarter to ten is 9:45. Sometimes the time changes in a dialogue, so we choose the last time.

Try this one. A: Is the class at nine? B: No, at ten. What time is the lesson?
